title: Goulburn 2015–2024 spot-observation availability and provisional ERS screening

seasonal.source: client aggregation of spot observations; Australian meteorological seasons

ers.source: EPA Victoria Environment Reference Standard, Table 5.8
ers.assessment_note: Provisional annual screening only. Table 5.8 percentile statistics are calculated separately for each calendar year and require at least 11 observations; objectives remain segment-specific.
ers.do_note: DO percent saturation is estimated from paired DO concentration, water temperature and site elevation; salinity and measured barometric pressure were unavailable.
ers.tn_note: Direct total nitrogen is used where available; otherwise TN is derived from paired TKN + NOx at the same site and timestamp.

Uplands B.context: Northern-draining uplands: Ovens, Broken and Goulburn (part)

Central Foothills and Coastal Plains.context: Foothills of Ovens, Broken and Goulburn basins

Murray and Western Plains.context: Lowlands of Kiewa, Ovens and Goulburn basins

quality_policy.note: Records with quality codes below 151 are retained except NV qualifiers; raw downloads are unchanged.
